item.title: DeLand salutes super students
item.description: Following a monthly tradition of the DeLand City Commission, Super Star Students for the month of March were recognized at the opening of the March 2 City Commission meeting. item.title: Glenwood Cemetery reflects the community’s compassion
item.description: Editor, The Beacon: This letter acknowledges the tireless work and devotion Glenwood residents have for their historic cemetery at Guava Street and Rogers Road, in unincorporated DeLand. This little jewel of a burial ground was established in 1891 by Julia Stone, to be used only by Glenwood residents. item.title: What future do we want for Deltona?
item.description: Editor, The Beacon: When we ask what Deltona will look like in 25 years, we are not asking an abstract planning question. We are asking what kind of place West Volusia intends to be. Deltona is a city where a large share of residents leave every morning to work elsewhere. We commute to Orange and Seminole counties. item.title: Breakfast Rotary turns 50
item.description: Members of the DeLand Breakfast Rotary Club assembled at the March 2 DeLand City Commission meeting to join the city in celebrating the club’s 50th anniversary.
